features.name: Talent Program
features.description: A Microsoft initiative designed to help partners find and develop new talent in Dynamics 365 Business Central. The program includes structured mentorship, practical work combined with theoretical learning, and community support.

features.name: Personalized Mentorship
features.description: The talent program features personalized guidance from mentors with vast knowledge who are accessible for queries and help participants navigate the ERP system.

features.name: Guided Learning Journey
features.description: The program provides a structured learning path that helps participants understand topic sequencing, moving from foundational to advanced topics with expert guidance for deep dives.

features.name: Practical and Theoretical Learning Integration
features.description: The talent program combines practical work experience with theoretical aspects of the ERP system and Business Central Dynamics.
